description: Most recent NOVEL drug approvals, in FDA/CDER's own sense of the word: a new drug or biologic never before approved or marketed in the U.S. (read live from FDA's own published Novel Drug Approvals list). Use for "what is the most recent novel drug the FDA approved", "how many novel drugs has CDER approved this year", "latest FDA drug approvals". Excludes generics, reformulations of an already-approved ingredient, and biosimilars — these are NOT on FDA's novel list even though they are "original" NDA/BLA submissions. Returns approval date, drug name, active ingredient, and approved use, sorted newest-first; application numbers/sponsors are not published on FDA's novel-drug page. Pass include_generics:true for a different, broader count (every original NDA/BLA/ANDA approval reconstructed from Drugs@FDA, reformulations/biosimilars included) — that path says so in its own note. Not for label text (fda_drug_labels) or searching a specific known drug (fda_drug_approvals).

include_generics.description: When true, switch from FDA's own novel-drug list to a broader Drugs@FDA reconstruction that also includes original ANDA (generic) approvals, reformulations, and biosimilars (default false — the default is FDA's own "novel" list, which excludes all of those).

skip.description: Offset into the newest-first results (default 0). total_in_window can exceed the 50-result cap on one call — pass skip=50 to page further into the window instead of assuming the window is fully covered.

name: fda_novel_approvals
title: Fda Novel Approvals
